Nova Basan Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Chernihiv Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Nova Basan's earliest evidence of a Jewish community dates to the first half of the 19th century; from 1908, the rabbi was Mordechai Krol, born 1880. By 1913, Jews were the town's only manufacturers. The community suffered two pogroms, in 1919 led by the Volunteer Army and in 1920 by the Romashko gang; only 2 Jewish families remained by 1941. Per the testimony of local resident Isaak Moiseyovych Menem, born 1911, this cemetery's land was appropriated for agricultural use between 1937 and 1940, though its last known Hasidic burial took place as late as 1941.
